sentences.en: I am convinced that things will change for the better.
sentences.zh: 我相信事情会变得更好。

sentences.en: You will soon be convinced that I am right.
sentences.zh: 你很快就会相信我是对的。

sentences.en: I am not wholly convinced that you are right.
sentences.zh: 我并不完全确信你是对的。

senses.zh: 使确信（convince的过去分词）；说服
